import json,math
from pathlib import Path
rows=[]
for p in sorted(Path("inputs").glob("s*.json")):
 d=json.load(open(p)); ts={t["id"]:t for t in d["trades"]};bad=[];err=0.;qerr=0.
 for x in d["metrics"]["funding"]["ledger"]:
  t=ts[x["trade_id"]]; sign=1 if t["type"]=="long" else -1
  err=max(err,abs(x["cashflow"]+x["qty"]*x["mark_price"]*x["rate_decimal"]));qerr=max(qerr,abs(x["qty"]-sign*t["qty"]))
  if not t["opened_at"]<=x["settled_at"]<=t["closed_at"]:bad.append({"ledger":x,"trade":{k:t[k] for k in ("id","type","opened_at","closed_at","qty")},"start_delta":x["settled_at"]-t["opened_at"],"end_delta":x["settled_at"]-t["closed_at"]})
 rows.append({"session":d["summary"]["session_id"],"bad_raw_time_count":len(bad),"first_bad":bad[:4],"max_formula_error":err,"max_qty_error":qerr})
print(json.dumps(rows))
